title: Bookstore database development with ChatGPT
summary: Junior database students translate a normalized bookstore model into a MySQL schema, populate it, and write retrieval queries. ChatGPT is permitted for schema, sample-data, and query support; students include a report section describing their interactions and assessing the tool's usefulness.
